attribution.note: Marcus's own words in his own Substack post. He is reading the Grok 4 launch chart for himself, not quoting anyone else.

semantics.note: The context ties the statement to the Grok 4 HLE graph and its orange 'with tool' dots. The normalised proposition keeps the model, the benchmark and the 'dramatically' wording. It is a causal reading of a reported comparison and adds nothing beyond what he said.

contract.note: Marcus pointed at the orange dots, which are xAI's tool-enabled configuration (Python plus Internet). Reading 'symbolic tools' as that configuration is the ordinary plain reading. If it meant code execution alone, the evidence could not separate it from search. Reading 'dramatically' as a substantial gain without a numeric cutoff is fair.

evidence.note: Scientific American (11 July 2025) reports xAI's launch figures: ordinary Grok 4 scored 25.4% on HLE without tools and 38.6% with tools. It lists Heavy separately, so the comparison is same model, same benchmark. These are company results, not a replication.

xAI's own launch page. It names the toolkit (code interpreter and web browsing) and the chart labels (No tool / With tool, Python and Internet tools). It describes the configuration but gives no readable numbers here.

reviews.rationale: xAI's reported launch results, relayed by Scientific American, show ordinary Grok 4 rising from 25.4% to 38.6% on HLE with tools, a 13.2-point (about 50% relative) gain. That is a fair reading of 'dramatically'. Caveats: the figures are company-reported and not independently replicated, search is bundled with code so the symbolic part is not isolated, and the training-chart subset may differ from the headline figures. No contrary evidence was found.
